utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to help, Cleo — I’ll swing by a bit late and check in on the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep the supplies ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m still checking on the time, but I heard we still need screws, tape, and a few hand towels. The tools look okay, and I’ll ask about the drill battery next.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — please let me know the repair drive time when you can, and I’ll note that we still need screws, tape, and a few hand towels.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’m still waiting on the time, and I’ll update you as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, Jules—I’ll keep an ear out and send anyone your way who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira—that means a lot. Keep me posted if anyone can spare tools or supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Jules—I’m heading out now, and I’ll pass along anyone who’s got tools or supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara. Sunday at the community center works for me — I’ll keep an eye out for the details and sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’ll send the updated details and sign-up list over soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll watch for it and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, Quinn — I’ll keep tracking the next stops and share them as soon as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep telling folks it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You’re welcome, Quinn — Sunday at the community center is locked in, and I’ll let you know if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — that’ll be perfect for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Faye — 9:30 works fine for me. I’ll bring the tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Gus — 9:30 Saturday works perfectly for the repair drive. I really appreciate you bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, quick update, Uli — the repair drive’s now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll let you know if anything changes again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. That works for me — I appreciate you keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet, Uli — I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything else about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. Please check the latest tally and let me know how many we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll check the latest tally and get back to you with the count, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — please let me know the latest count when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to help, Rosa. I’ll bring what tools I can and check in with you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Rey — thank you. The most urgent spots are the front-step railing, a leaky faucet in the kitchen, and a loose screen door at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Rosa — I’ll start with whichever urgent repair you need first and check in with you Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Rey — see you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: See you Sunday, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks Rey — I’ll let the others know it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m a bit late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re still short on tape, screwdrivers, and one folding table. If you can, grab those and meet me at the church hall.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll grab the tape, screwdrivers, and a folding table, then head to the church hall.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: We’re set for Sunday at the community center now — I keep mixing that up. If you remind me later, I’ll make sure everything’s on track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’ll remind you later, and I’m just checking the timing and what to bring so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Sunday at the community center — thanks for checking. I’ll sort the timing and make a list of what to bring, and a reminder later would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard you’re short on duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and some spare screws — I can keep an eye out for those and bring them by if I find them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll keep an eye out and bring them by if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Sunday at the community center. Thanks for the update, Opal!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Exactly — Sunday at the community center. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, I’ll head there Sunday. Thanks again, Opal!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, glad that’s all set. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Bo — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you there!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s Sunday at the community center now, right? Just want to confirm the new details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the full details soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — Sunday at the community center, then. Please send the full details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — what time is the repair drive, and do we still need hands, tools, or any spare supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s at 10 in the morning at the community hall, and we still need a few extra hands plus basic tools and spare screws if anyone has them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — 10 a.m. at the community hall, and we still need extra hands, basic tools, and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday at 9 at the community center and help sort everything out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam — Sunday at 9 at the community center it is. I’ll let folks know the new plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Tess — thanks for updating everyone. I’ll see you Sunday at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it’s on—please go ahead and tell people. I’ll keep you updated as folks volunteer and line up supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s Sunday at the community center now, right? I’ll only pass that along if that’s still the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — Sunday at the community center is still the plan. Thanks for spreading the word; I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Noah — I’m still set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep an eye out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, Sunday at the community center is right — thanks, Mara. I’ll send any updates if they come up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — I’ll keep an eye out for any updates and be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes — I can bring the screwdriver set and gloves on Sunday at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Uli. I’ll plan on Sunday at 9 at the community center and keep you on the quieter jobs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That works for me — I’ll stick to the quieter jobs on Sunday at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — just make sure everyone knows it’s Sunday at the community center now, so nobody goes to the porch by mistake.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, it’s Sunday at the community center now — I’ll pass that along and bring my tools there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’m mostly worried folks will miss the change, so please include the timing and bring-list too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — the biggest needs are still the same, so let’s start there and match volunteers to each repair.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll help match each repair to the right volunteers so we can keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that’ll keep things moving smoothly. Let’s start assigning the biggest repairs first and we’ll be set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — the repair drive’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll let you know what they need most first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for your update on what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll update you once I hear what they need most first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye — I’ll be ready right after pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks—right after pickup works for me too. Let’s aim for 9:30 and we can get started once school drop-off’s done.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9:30 works for me, Faye — I’ll be ready right after drop-off is done.
